results.description:
Track your bike rides, runs, hikes, and swims with GPS routes, heart rate, and on-device AI coaching — on iPhone and Apple Watch. Train from 5K to Ironman. Your data never leaves your phone.

MULTI-SPORT, ONE APP
Record road, mountain, gravel, indoor, commute, and e-bike rides; runs, trail runs, treadmill sessions, and walks; hikes; pool and open water swims; and triathlon races (Sprint, Olympic, Half and Full Ironman, custom) with T1/T2 transitions.

REAL-TIME METRICS
Speed, distance, duration, heart rate, elevation, cadence, power, and calories as you move. A large speedometer keeps your pace visible at a glance. Auto-pause detects stops and resumes on its own. Outdoor activities wait for GPS lock and count down before starting the clock.

APPLE WATCH COMPANION
Start, pause, resume, and stop from your wrist. Live metrics mirror iPhone. Watch-started workouts sync back automatically. Smart Stack widget gives a quick fitness glance. Control Center action starts a ride in two taps.

TURN-BY-TURN NAVIGATION
Search for a destination or POI, then follow turn-by-turn visual guidance. Off-route detection reroutes you automatically. Import GPX, KML, GeoJSON, or FIT files and follow saved routes live.

ON-DEVICE TRAINING INTELLIGENCE
Readiness scoring, workout anomaly detection, and plan-match analysis run on device. On supported devices, Apple Intelligence adds optional natural-language coaching summaries, ride-name suggestions, and training tips — all local, nothing sent to a server.

PERSONALIZED TRAINING ZONES
Kiito detects your aerobic and anaerobic thresholds from ride data and builds personalized HR zones and FTP-based power zones. Plan workouts show target BPM and watt ranges tailored to you.

CARDIO ANALYTICS
Every activity gets a Cardio Impact score, dominant training zone, perceived effort, HR-over-time chart with zone bands, zone duration breakdown, and post-exercise HR recovery rated against age-adjusted benchmarks.

ADAPTIVE TRAINING PLANS
Running, cycling, swimming, triathlon, VO2 max, and cross-training plans at beginner, intermediate, or advanced levels, structured in Base, Build, Peak, Taper, Recovery, and Technique phases. On-device AI reviews your recent load, readiness, and HR trends and proposes week-by-week adjustments — shorter tempo blocks when you need recovery, longer endurance pushes when you're trending up. Accept or reject each suggestion. Weeks anchor to Monday (ISO), planned-vs-actual minutes show side by side, and a Skip action lets you move past a workout without breaking the week.

VOICE COACH
Real-time audio cues for distance and time checkpoints, speed, heart rate zone changes, cadence, power, motivation, hydration reminders, and interval events. Adjust frequency and volume to suit your ride.

PRIVACY-FIRST ROUTE HEATMAP
All your routes overlaid on one map, colour-coded by sport. Automatic home blur protects your location. Toggle categories, switch map tiles, or tap any route to open its detail.

BIKE MANAGEMENT
Add unlimited bikes with custom names, types, colours, and weights. Track per-bike distance, duration, elevation, and calories. Link any ride to a specific bike.

LIVE ACTIVITY & DYNAMIC ISLAND
Distance and heart rate on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island without unlocking your phone.

FITNESS SCORE
A daily 0–100 composite score based on consistency, volume, intensity, and recovery over the past 14 days, with 90-day trend charts.

FREE TO RIDE
Record activities, track routes, manage bikes, and view your heatmap — free, forever. Upgrade to Kiito Pro for plans, analytics, AI coaching, and personalized zones. Try Pro free for 7 days, then $5.99/month or $44.99/year.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage subscriptions in your Apple ID settings. Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Your data stays on your device. Always.

Want to place a bet, but too lazy to analyze the line, search for the best options and dig into the odds? «Tips Generator" will do all the work for you. The application works with a huge closed database of predictions (80 000+ predictions per day), and also analyzes users' bets from different resources. The generator will select the best outcomes based on statistical data, frequency of repetition of the given outcome, data about the author, as well as many other parameters and and bring them to you. You will only have to choose whether you like them or not.

There are several generation modes available in the application:

1. Random generation
The generator will select the optimal parameters and create tips based on them.
2. Custom generation
The user can set custom parameters based on his needs. You can choose:
* Sports
* Range of odds
* Start time of events
All tips in this mode will be generated according to the user's settings.
3. Preset templates
The user can use pre-selected presets of settings, as well as edit them based on his needs. 
4. Saved Settings
The user can save their own customizations as templates for quick use. 

Once tips are generated you can save them to favorites (by simply swiping to the right as in the all famous app) and track their results. 

We hope that with «Tips Generator" you can improve your betting results or just have fun.
